projectionContracts.name: EXACT_ACTIVE_SOURCE_SUPPORT
projectionContracts.preserves: Atom occurrence identity and exact membership when completeness is Exact.
projectionContracts.discards: Multiplicity, joint-versus-alternative structure, operation order, payload, authenticity, and authority.
projectionContracts.replayabilitySemantics: Carries an explicit payload-replayability declaration; the projection does not prove that declaration.

projectionContracts.name: TOTAL_ATOM_OCCURRENCE_MULTIPLICITY
projectionContracts.preserves: Atom identity and total syntactic occurrence count across the positive derivation expression.
projectionContracts.discards: Grouping into joint terms, alternative branches, operation order, payload, authenticity, and authority.
projectionContracts.replayabilitySemantics: Carries an explicit payload-replayability declaration; the projection does not prove that declaration.

projectionContracts.name: RAW_PRIME_PRODUCT_SUPPORT
projectionContracts.preserves: Active support with declared completeness; exact only when completeness is Exact under one injective prime registry.
projectionContracts.discards: Joint-versus-alternative structure, operation history, payload, issuer authenticity, and registry-free meaning.
projectionContracts.replayabilitySemantics: Carries the embedded support projection's explicit payload-replayability declaration; the product does not prove it.

projectionContracts.name: SPARSE_ATOM_EXPONENTS

projectionContracts.discards: Joint-versus-alternative grouping, operation history, payload, authenticity, and unregistered atoms.
projectionContracts.replayabilitySemantics: Carries an explicit payload-replayability declaration; the sparse exponents do not prove it.

projectionContracts.name: DENSE_BINARY_PEV_SUPPORT
projectionContracts.preserves: Exact active support under a fixed registry when completeness is Exact.
projectionContracts.discards: Multiplicity, joint-versus-alternative structure, operation history, payload, authenticity, and cross-epoch meaning.
projectionContracts.replayabilitySemantics: Carries an explicit payload-replayability declaration; the bitset does not prove it.

dagReplay.detail: All reachable node shapes, canonical normal forms, references, hashes, and requested DigestOnly structural projection caches replayed exactly. This does not establish payload availability or issuer authentication.

verification.detail: The envelope content address, registry binding, and derivation replay are valid. This integrity result establishes no issuer authentication or empirical validity.

claimCeiling: Bounded exact-software and abstract-structure evidence under PAS-BUILD004-EXACT-LINEAGE-0001 only; no source-authenticity, empirical-validity, privacy, cryptographic-security, PAL-conformance, universal-performance, or hardware-PPA claim.
